name: @zyo/yield
description: Oilskin yield service (Base module): live Aave v3 USDC borrow + collateral supply/LT from the PoolDataProvider, Aerodrome gauge emissions per range width, the IL-drag yield gate, and empirical realized-APR bands from the Snuggle engine's on-chain history — served over a small HTTP API. Zero runtime dependencies by design.

scripts.model: npm run model-inputs && node scripts/run-model.mjs --sample samples/gauge-emissions-2026-09-13.json
